entries.en: Added support for organization default models — admins set it in the org console; it shows as "Org default" (or "Role default") in `/model` when you haven't picked one yourself
entries.zh: 添加了对组织默认模型的支持 - 管理员在组织控制台中设置它；当您自己没有选择一个时，它会在`/model`中显示为“组织默认值”（或“角色默认值”）

entries.en: Added readable default names for sessions at start, making them easier to identify and message
entries.zh: 在启动时为会话添加了可读的默认名称，使它们更易于识别和发送消息

entries.en: Added clickable file attachments in chat — Cmd/Ctrl-click reveals the file in Finder/Explorer
entries.zh: 在聊天中添加了可点击的文件附件 - Cmd/Ctrl-单击在 Finder/Explorer 中显示文件

entries.en: Improved background session reliability: long-running commands and workflows now survive the session's process being stopped, restarted, or updated — including on Windows, where background shells are handed off instead of being killed
entries.zh: 改进后台会话可靠性：长时间运行的命令和工作流，在会话进程被停止、重启或更新后仍能存活，包括 Windows 上后台 shell 会被移交而不是被终止

entries.en: Improved background agents: workers killed by a daemon restart are now automatically resumed from where they left off the next time the agents view opens
entries.zh: 改进后台 agent：因守护进程重启而中断的 worker，下次打开 agents 视图时会自动从中断处恢复

entries.en: Improved `/code-review` workflow: merged five cleanup finders into one, cutting token usage by roughly 25%
entries.zh: 改进 `/code-review` 流程：把五个清理检查器合并为一个，token 用量约减少 25%

entries.en: Reduced per-frame rendering work in the terminal UI by skipping no-op subtree walks during streaming
entries.zh: 流式输出期间跳过无变化的子树遍历，终端界面每帧的渲染工作量降低

entries.en: The streaming idle watchdog is now on by default for all providers — it aborts and retries when a response stream produces no events for 5 minutes. Set `CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG=0` to disable.
entries.zh: 流式空闲看门狗现已对所有提供商默认开启：响应流超过 5 分钟没有任何事件时，会中止并重试。设置 `CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG=0` 可关闭

entries.en: Remote Control is now disabled when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at a non-Anthropic host, matching the existing behavior under `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK`/`_VERTEX`/`_FOUNDRY`
entries.zh: 当 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 指向非 Anthropic 主机时，Remote Control 现已禁用，与 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK`/`_VERTEX`/`_FOUNDRY` 下的现有行为一致

entries.en: Changed opening the agents view from a foreground session to require a single `←` press instead of two, matching the behavior in background sessions
entries.zh: 更改了从前台会话打开代理视图的方式，要求按一次`←`而不是两次，与后台会话中的行为相匹配

entries.en: Security: `claude mcp list`/`get` no longer spawn `.mcp.json` servers that a repo self-approved via a committed `.claude/settings.json`; untrusted workspaces show `⏸ Pending approval`
entries.zh: 安全：`claude mcp list`/`get` 不再启动仓库通过已提交的 `.claude/settings.json` 自行批准的 `.mcp.json` 服务器；不受信任的工作区会显示 `⏸ Pending approval`

entries.en: Fixed waking a background job permanently deleting its conversation and re-running the original prompt when the transcript probe misread a real transcript; the file is now set aside, never deleted
entries.zh: 修复唤醒后台任务时，因转录探测误读了真实转录，导致其对话被永久删除并重新执行原始提示的问题；现在该文件会被另行存放，而不会被删除

entries.en: Fixed the rate-limit warning flickering off and rate-limit telemetry being over-counted when multiple parallel requests were in flight at the moment a usage limit was hit
entries.zh: 修复在碰到用量上限的瞬间有多个并行请求在途时，速率限制警告闪烁熄灭，且速率限制遥测被多计数的问题

entries.en: Fixed duplicate recap lines after a background session's turn: a schema-rejected StructuredOutput attempt no longer renders alongside its retry
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话轮后重复的回顾行：模式拒绝的 StructuredOutput 尝试不再与重试一起呈现

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell `git diff`/`git grep`, `egrep`/`fgrep`, and quoted search patterns containing `|` being reported as failures when they exit 1, matching Bash behavior
entries.zh: 修复了 PowerShell `git diff`/`git grep`、`egrep`/`fgrep` 以及包含 `|` 的引用搜索模式在退出 1 时被报告为失败的问题，与 Bash 行为相匹配

entries.en: Fixed multiple `claude agents` side panel issues: keyboard focus getting stuck when opening an agent, background jobs losing their subagent types on every open, and sessions showing incorrect status while actively running
entries.zh: 修复了多个“克劳德代理”侧面板问题：打开代理时键盘焦点卡住，后台作业在每次打开时丢失其子代理类型，以及会话在主动运行时显示不正确的状态

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents --dangerously-skip-permissions` silently falling back to auto mode instead of showing the bypass disclaimer and applying bypass mode to spawned agents
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents --dangerously-skip-permissions”默默地回退到自动模式，而不是显示绕过免责声明并将旁路模式应用于生成的代理

entries.en: Fixed mid-turn crash recovery for Remote sessions — sessions interrupted by a server restart now auto-resume on the next worker
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话的中途崩溃恢复 - 由于服务器重启而中断的会话现在可以在下一个工作人员上自动恢复

entries.en: Fixed sessions moved with `/cd` reappearing in the old directory's resume list after a non-graceful exit when the old path contained special characters
entries.zh: 修复了当旧路径包含特殊字符时，在非正常退出后，使用`/cd`移动的会话重新出现在旧目录的恢复列表中的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` skipping local plugins whose source is "." and stopping after the first error class
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`跳过源为“.”的本地插件的问题。并在第一个错误类别后停止

entries.en: Fixed Esc Esc at an idle prompt not opening the rewind menu (regression); use Ctrl+C or Ctrl+X Ctrl+K to stop background agents
entries.zh: 修复了空闲提示时 Esc Esc 不打开快退菜单的问题（回归）；使用 Ctrl+C 或 Ctrl+X Ctrl+K 停止后台代理

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth requesting the authorization server's full `scopes_supported` catalog when no scope is specified, causing `invalid_scope` failures on GitLab self-hosted and other enterprise IdPs
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP OAuth 在未指定范围时请求授权服务器的完整`scopes_supported`目录，导致 GitLab 自托管和其他企业 IdP 上的`invalid_scope`失败

entries.en: Fixed `/context` showing 0 tokens for all tool groups on Bedrock
entries.zh: 修复了基岩上所有工具组的`/context`显示 0 标记的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/deep-research` misreporting verifier failures as "all claims refuted" instead of `unverified`
entries.zh: 修复了`/deep-research`将验证器失败误报为“所有声明均被驳回”而不是“未经验证”的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin dependency version pins not being honored when the marketplace was added as a local folder path backed by a git repo
entries.zh: 修复了当市场被添加为 git 存储库支持的本地文件夹路径时，插件依赖版本引脚不被接受的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` session status: completed rows no longer flip between "Done" and "Needs your input", stalled agents are now labeled "Needs attention", and results that mention a PR show a clickable link
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”会话状态：已完成的行不再在“完成”和“需要您的输入”之间切换，停滞的代理现在被标记为“需要注意”，提及 PR 的结果显示可点击的链接

entries.en: Fixed voice dictation swallowing spaces and spuriously starting a recording during very fast typing when voice mode is enabled
entries.zh: 修复开启语音模式后，极快速打字时语音听写吞掉空格并意外开始录音的问题
